---
title: "EXP-0001 — SiRA simulative versus reactive protocol"
---

## Current state

`EXP-0001` is **planned**, its evidence is **not evaluated**, and its outcome is
**pending**. One T07 one-step reactive/simulative artifact smoke occurred and T08
adjudicated it as a valid matched pair with documented evidence gaps. Both sessions
recorded `is_complete: false`, so task completion was not observed. The smoke contains
no EXP-0001 measurement or outcome. T09 V4 later produced one descriptive full-task
calibration measurement: Task A reactive completed and the exact evaluator scored it
0.0. Its paired Task A simulative attempt and both Task B attempts did not run, so no
realized pair, checkpoint, condition comparison, or EXP-0001 outcome exists. V3 and
V4 single-use authority is exhausted and provider cleanup is verified. V5 repaired
the downstream finalizer but stopped before any new empirical attempt, so the V4
measurement remains the only descriptive calibration record. V6 later qualified the
retained replacement image and consumed Task A reactive once, but a core artifact
exceeded the raw-output cap and prevented an immutable raw seal. That attempt is
infrastructure-invalid and unscored; the other three V6 attempts did not run. V6 adds
no measurement, realized pair, checkpoint, comparison, or EXP-0001 outcome.

## Locked exploratory comparison

The treatment is exactly `SIRA-SIMULATIVE`; the control is exactly `SIRA-REACTIVE`.
Both are assigned externally by the experiment. The assignment is not evidence of a
learned internal regulation mechanism.

The smoke is one minimal matched pair on the pinned README query and prohibits
interpretation. Its retained aggregate was 9 model calls, 11,588 tokens, two browser
actions, 39.397 seconds, and USD 0.0403325; these are artifact-execution accounting,
not comparative results or representative full-task costs. The pilot is two
counterbalanced FanOutQA task pairs selected only to exercise full completion, exact
deterministic scoring, matched execution, reconstruction, gross floor/ceiling checks,
and cost calibration. It cannot estimate an effect or variance, support significance
or condition superiority, accept/reject EXP-0001, or support an H2K/GIC architectural
claim.

The historical upstream run used the mutable `gpt-4o` alias without an immutable
serving revision. The proposed protocol substitutes a dated GPT-4o snapshot. Any later
evidence must therefore be called a **directional reproduction under a declared model
substitution**, never an unqualified reproduction.

## Evidence and future-track boundary

Raw traces, commands, configuration, environment identity, timestamps, hashes, costs,
and cleanup evidence are retained before normalization. Public raw release remains
blocked pending licensing, privacy, and redaction review.

T08 classifies cleanup as verified with a nonmaterial gap: private provider-response
artifacts retained inactive ephemeral Jupyter access fields beyond the historical API-
key scan. No values are published, the provider instance is terminally absent, and
future retention must omit or structurally redact them. T09 resolved the offline
evaluator, dataset, evidence, pair, budget-arithmetic, and identity contracts in
`PLAN-EXP0001-PILOT-V2`. The current pragmatic successor,
`PLAN-EXP0001-PILOT-V3`, preserved those scientific locks while parameterizing the
existing observer with a 14,400-second actual-time campaign, 900-second cleanup
reserve, and 13,500-second termination cutoff. The reviewed V3 package launched one
A10 host, but the source rebuild did not match the frozen required container digest
and no verified loadable copy of that image was retained. The runtime gate therefore
stopped before any model request, task browser action, condition, evaluator, or score.
The host was terminated and zero T09 instances were verified. This is infrastructure
preflight evidence, not a pilot result; V3 authority is exhausted.

V4 requalified and froze replacement image `sha256:e2603f5a…`, then ran Task A
reactive once. The frozen finalizer failed on an incorrect command-manifest
output-root projection and an interpreter/dependency mismatch. A single
network-disabled reconstruction of the retained prefix established task completion
and the score without another task call, browser action, or condition retry. That
changed reconstruction invocation could not be used for later conditions under the
post-entry freeze, so the campaign stopped before pair completion. The exact host is
terminal/absent, zero T09 instances and restored security are verified. This one
descriptive attempt supports pipeline/cost calibration only, not a condition claim.

V5 separated immutable raw evidence from versioned finalized output and twice
reproduced the repaired finalizer against the exact V4 archive with networking
disabled. Its first authorized host built and preserved a candidate runtime, then
stopped before metadata or empirical entry on a private archive path error. Its second
and final host stopped before access or dynamic preflight when provider activation
left less than one full condition wall plus the protected cleanup reserve. Both hosts
are terminal or absent, zero T09 instances and restored security are verified, and V5
recorded zero metadata requests, task model calls, browser actions, conditions,
evaluators, or scores. This is infrastructure/calibration-control evidence only; it
adds no EXP-0001 measurement and cannot be replayed.

V6 repaired content-addressed regression-archive staging and separated cumulative
active-provider, per-launch preflight, and post-freeze empirical clocks. Its final
host imported and fully qualified image `sha256:abe8ed38…` before the fresh empirical
clock. Task A reactive entered once and retained 20 model calls, 38,779 tokens, five
requested browser actions, and four post-action results. A 234,479,616-byte core file
then exceeded the 67,108,864-byte attempt-output cap. The container stopped with exit
143 and the raw-complete seal failed closed, so task completion, evaluator validity,
and score are unavailable. No later condition ran. Both hosts are terminal/absent,
zero T09 instances and restored security are verified. This is operational evidence
only and cannot be replayed.

The exact upstream evaluator is deliberately not repaired or renormalized. Offline
fixtures show Task A's ordinary correct prose scoring 0.9 (with a normalization-edge
fixture at 1.0) and Task B's correct currency-answer fixture scoring 0.5 because of
the pinned evaluator's dollar-sign word-boundary behavior. These are evaluator
properties, not pilot results, and require task-level descriptive reporting only.

The FanOutQA rows are CC-BY-SA-4.0 and private access-controlled research retention is
permitted. Public raw tasks, answers, traces, and screenshots remain blocked pending
attribution/share-alike, third-party-content, privacy, and redaction review. This
publication-only restriction does not authorize or block the private pilot itself.

The protocol also retains source-grounded regulation-decision provenance for the
planned/deferred `RQ-H2K` track. This is an additive evidence-preservation appendix,
not an EXP-0001 hypothesis, metric, outcome, treatment, control, ablation, training
condition, or interpretation. Trace sufficiency supports only source classification
and lineage; it does not support internalization.

See the generated [experiment registry](../generated/experiments.qmd) for canonical
lifecycle, evidence, and outcome state.
